assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
To correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity, a mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
CPT 93229 Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is the service ordered.
The medical necessity of CPT 93229 is supported by the clinical indication note.
The associated diagnosis codes are R00.2 and R42.
R00.2 reflects the presenting symptom of absent/pause in sensation of heartbeat.
R42 reflects the presenting symptom of syncope/loss of consciousness.
The payer's letter acknowledges the service as Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The payer ties coverage to medical necessity.
The denial under CO-197 is inconsistent with the documented reason for ordering this diagnostic procedure.
